title: WPSS/33383/1997 of KRISHNA AVATAR SHARMA Vs ENGR. IN CHIEF ,IRRIGATION andORS

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL.
Writ Petition no. 5571 of 2001 (S/S)
(Old No. 33383/1997)
Krishna Avtar Sharma. ----Petitioner.
Vs.
Engineer in Chief, Irrigation Department, Lucknow
And six others. ----Respondents.
Mr. S.S. Yadav, Advocate for the petitioner,
Mr. H.M. Raturi, Standing Counsel for the State,
Dated: September 7, 2009.
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
Present petition has been filed by the petitioner for
the following reliefs:-
a. "To issue a writ of certiorari or other suitable writ,
order or direction calling for the record concerning
the order dated 11/16.07.1997 passed by respondent
no. 3 (contained in annexure no. 1 to the writ
petition) and order dated 11.07.1996 (contained in
annexure no. 6 to this writ petition) and to quash
the same;
b. To issue a writ of mandamus or other suitable writ,
order or direction commanding the respondent nos.
1,2,3 & 4 either to promote the petitioner or
consider petitioner's promotion for the post of
Seench Paryavekshak and subsequent promotions
prior to promotion of respondent nos. 5, 6 & 7 and
petitioner may be ordered to be placed senior to
respondent nos. 5 to 7 in seniority list;
c. In addition to or in substitution thereof the above
reliefs any other suitable writ, order or direction
may kindly be issued in favour of the petitioner for
which he may be found entitled to in the facts and
circumstances of the case and fitness of things.
d. To award costs."
2. Brief facts of the case are that petitioner was initially
appointed in the Irrigation Department on 25.01.1975.
Consequent upon completion of 6 years' service as
'Seenchpal' and on completion of more than 16 years'

2
service as such, he was given selection grade and
thereafter promotional pay scale. It is averred in the writ
petition that in the year 1993 a seniority list of 'Seenchpal'
was prepared on 13.12.1993 at the level of Chief Engineer,
(North), Irrigation Department in which the petitioner
was placed at Sl. No. 9, while the respondents Harnarayan
Lal, Ram Kishore Singh and Shasthi Ballabh were placed
at Sl. No. 4, 16 and 31 respectively. Contrary to it another
seniority list of 'Seenchpal' purported to be of Rudrapur
Division was prepared on 27.04.1997 wherein the
petitioner is shown at Sl.No. 11, respondent Harnarayan
Lal was shown at Sl. No. 16, Ram Kishore Singh was
shown at Sl. No. 1 in the category of Scheduled Tribe and
the respondent Shasthi Ballabh was shown at Sl. No. 53. It
is further stated that the promotions to the post of
'Amin'/'Seench Paryavekshak' are regulated by Irrigation
Department Amin Service Rules, 1954 and for making
promotion to the post of 'Seench Paryavekshak' from the
post of 'Seenchpal' an examination is to be passed by an
incumbent but without conducting any examination vide
order dated 09.06.1993 eight persons, including the
petitioner, were directed to appear in the selection on the
post of 'Seench Paryavekshak'. The grievance of the
petitioner is that in case examination for promotion to the
post of 'Seench Paryavekshak' would have taken place
timely, the petitioner would have been promoted to the
post of 'Seench Paryavekshak' much earlier and after
completion of 5 years of service on that post he would
have been prom0ted as 'Ziledar'. In the present petition
the petitioner is aggrieved with the promotion order dated
11/16.07.1997 and order dated 11.07.1996 by which the
respondent nos. 5, 6 & 7 were promoted as 'Seench
Paryavekshak'.

3
3. Heard Mr. S.S. Yadav, learned counsel for the
petitioner and Mr. H.M. Raturi, learned Standing Counsel
for the State/respondents and perused the entire material
available on record.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner Mr. S.S. Yadav
argued that as per the seniority list issued by the Chief
Engineer, (North), Irrigation Department the respondent
nos. 5, 6 & 7 are junior to the petitioner and in view of this
factual aspect the promotion given to respondent nos. 5, 6
& 7 on the post of 'Seench Paryavekshak' is wholly
discriminatory and deserves to be set-aside. He further
submitted that petitioner being senior to respondent nos.
5, 6 & 7 is entitled for promotion with effect from the date
it was granted to respondent nos. 5,6 & 7.
5. The respondent nos. 2 to 4 have filed their joint
counter affidavit and supplementary counter affidavit in
which they denied the contention of the petitioner. In
paragraph-4 of the counter affidavit the respondent nos. 2
to 4 have specifically denied that persons junior to the
petitioner have been promoted by the respondents. In
paragraph-8 of the counter affidavit the respondent nos. 2
to 4 denied that seniority list dated 13.12.1993 was issued
by the Chief Engineer (North), Irrigation Department.
According to respondent nos. 2, 3 & 4 the said list was
issued by the Executive Engineer, Irrigation Division,
Rudrapur. Refuting the averment by which the petitioner
has contended that in the year 1993 a seniority list of
'Seenchpal' was prepared on 13.12.1993 at the level of
Chief Engineer, (North), Irrigation Department in which
the petitioner was placed at Sl. No. 9, while the
respondents Harnarayan Lal, Ram Kishore Singh and

4
Shasthi Ballabh were placed at Sl. No. 4, 16 and 31
respectively, the respondents have come up with the
categorical contention that the seniority list was prepared
by Executive Engineer, Irrigation Division, Rudrapur and
not by the Chief Engineer, (North), Irrigation
Department. In paragraph-4 of the supplementary
counter affidavit dated 9th October, 2006 a categorical
averment has been made by the respondents whereby it is
stated that the date of appointment of respondent no.5 is
30.05.1974 and the date of appointment of respondent
no.6 is 30.06.1961 and they are seniors to the petitioner.
The fact regarding seniority of the respondent nos. 5,6 & 7
has again been reiterated in paragraph-4 of the
supplementary counter affidavit dated 09.10.2006. In
support of their contention, the respondents have also
annexed the final seniority list of 'Seenchpals'. Paragraph
nos. 4 & 8 of the counter affidavit and paragraph no. 4 of
the supplementary counter affidavit are quoted
hereunder:-
Paragraph-4 of the counter affidavit-"That the
contents of para-2 of the writ petition, as stated are
denied. In fact, the respondent nos. 5 and 6 have
been promoted by the respondent no.3 in
compliance of the order No. 1884/Sikam/R-4 dated
05.04.1997 and 5746/Sikam/R-4 dated 07.07.1997
of the respondent no. 2 i.e. Superintending
Engineer, Irrigation Works Circle, Nainital, in which
Sri Harnarayan Lal i.e. respondent no. 5 is senior
then petitioner and Sri Ram Kishore Singh i.e.
respondent no.6 is of schedule tribe. Sri Khasthi
Ballabh, Seenchpal, who is appointed on dated
09.01.1989 has not been promoted, while Sri
Shasthi Ballabh Kothari- respondent no.7 has been
promoted, whose date of appointment is dated
30.12.1973, therefore, it is incorrect and misleading
to state that persons junior to petitioner has been
promoted by the respondents."
Paragraph-8 of the counter affidavit-"That in reply
to the contents of para-6 of the writ petition, it is
stated that the petitioner has stated that the

5
seniority list prepared by the Chief Engineer, North
is correct, while the said list was not prepared by the
Chief Engineer, North, but is prepared by Executive
Engineer, Irrigation Division, Rudrapur on the basis
of same list, those who were given promotion,
except those are in reservation quota, are still
working as Seenchpal and they are in waiting list."
Paragraph-4 of the supplementary counter affidavit-
"That the contents of para-5 of the supplementary
affidavit, as stated are misconceived, erroneous,
hence denied. It is stated that the date of
appointment of Sri Har Narayan Lal, respondent
no.5 as per his service book is dated 30.05.1974, as
stated earlier in para-6 of the counter affidavit. The
seniority list prepared at the circle level, the name of
Sri Harnarayan Lal, Seench Paryavekshak was
shown at serial no. 16 due to his date of
appointment wrongly mentioned dated 30.05.1977,
while his actual date of appointment as per service
book is dated 30.05.1974. Sri Ram Kishore, who was
retired from the service on dated 31.03.1997, was
appointed as Seenchpal dated 30.06.1961 in regular
establishment and from dated 19.09.1981 he had
worked as Seench Paryavekshak. Another Ram
Kishore Rana was appointed on dated 21.11.1981,
his date of birth is 10.01.1952 as per service record
and he will be retired on dated 31.10.2012. The said
orders of promotion was stayed on dated 11.04.1997
by Irrigation Work Circle, Nainital and on dated
07.07.1997, the said order had been cancelled. Mr.
Shashi Ballabh Kothari was posted on the post of
Seench Paryavekshak from dated 14.09.1990, the
Superintending Engineer, Irrigation Work Circle,
Nainital had requested to Chief Engineer (North),
Haldwani to retained him to his original division at
Ranikhet vide his letter dated 18.10.1996."
6. Thus, it is established that the respondent nos. 5 & 7
are seniors to the petitioner and respondent no. 6 was
promoted under the Scheduled Tribe category. Since the
petitioner is not senior to the respondent nos. 5 & 7 and
the respondent no.6 belongs to the Scheduled Tribe
category, their promotion cannot be set-aside on the
behest of petitioner.

6
7. In view of the foregoing discussion the writ petition
is dismissed. No order as to costs.
 (V.K. Bisht, J.)
 07.09.2009
